# Smarter steels for people and planet

ArcelorMittal is redefining steel for the modern world
* [
  Learn about us
  ][138]

[AM_Hero.jpg]

## Global operations bring a world of opportunity

ArcelorMittal’s unique global reach brings many advantages: consistency for our customers, mobility
for our people, diversification for our investors and resilience for our business. And as we
continue to grow responsibly, so do the opportunities we create.
* [See how we lead][139]

## Reflections from our CEO on 20 years of ArcelorMittal

As ArcelorMittal approaches its 20-year anniversary, our CEO, Aditya Mittal, looks back on two
decades of progress and discusses the priorities that will shape our future. 
* [Read more][140]

[Steel Talks Corp.png]

## Powering the energy transition with electrical steels

In the second episode of a three-part series exploring ArcelorMittal’s role in the energy
transition, host Tom Cheesewright is joined by ArcelorMittal Automotive and Electrical Steels
leaders from North America, Europe, China and Global R&D.
* [Listen to the full episode][141]

## Cleveland-Cliffs Awarded 2025 GM Supplier of the Year by General Motors

Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. was named a 2025 GM Supplier of the Year by General Motors at its 34th annual
Supplier of the Year event. Cleveland-Cliffs was the only North American steel producer recognized
this year. This is the ninth time the company has received the award.

[ View Press Release ][47]

## Congressional Steel Caucus Hearing

Lourenco Goncalves, Cliffs Chairman, President & Chief Executive Officer and the Board Chairman of
the American Iron and Steel Institute provided testimony at the Congressional Steel Caucus held on
January 14, 2026.  Mr. Goncalves spoke about the importance of maintaining Section 232 steel tariffs
and fair trade for the steel industry in the United States. 

The Congressional Steel Caucus is a bipartisan group of U.S. Representatives and Senators working to
support the American steel industry, its workers, and its vital role in national security and
infrastructure, advocating through legislation, meetings with officials, and challenging unfair
trade practices.

Read Mr. Goncalves' testimony, [click here][48]

[ Watch Steel Caucus Hearing on YouTube ][49]

## Cleveland-Cliffs Announces POSCO as MoU Counterparty

Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is pleased to announce that POSCO, Korea’s largest steelmaker and the world’s
third largest steelmaker outside of China, is its strategic partner under the previously disclosed
transformative Memorandum of Understanding. The MoU between the two companies was executed on
September 17, 2025. With the recent completion of the new U.S. and Korea trade agreement,
cooperation between the two nations’ industrial sectors will be further reinforced by the
POSCO-Cliffs partnership.

Read more in the complete News Release.

[ Read News Release ][50]

## Steel Tariffs

The United States’ steel tariffs continue to play a vital role in supporting the long-term strength,
stability, and competitiveness of the domestic steel industry. In 2025, President Trump restored the
effectiveness of steel Section 232 tariffs by increasing the tariff rate from 25% to 50%, completely
eliminating exclusions and exemptions that had drastically weakened the measures and adding Section
232 tariff coverage of certain steel  derivative products. Trade measures such as Section 232
tariffs are essential to countering persistent global steel overcapacity and unfair trade practices
that distort markets and undermine U.S. producers. These tariff measures help ensure that America
maintains a reliable domestic steel supply critical to sustain U.S. national security.

There are early indications of positive impact, including moderated import pressure and improved
conditions for domestic production. Full year 2025 finished steel imports were down 17% vs. 2024.
However, the full benefits of these tariffs will take time to be fully realized. Steelmaking is a
capital-intensive, long-cycle industry, and meaningful gains in capacity utilization, reinvestment,
and workforce development occur gradually.

## CNBC Invest in America Forum

Lourenco Goncalves, Cleveland-Cliffs Chairman, President & CEO participated at the CNBC Invest in
America Forum. Moderated by Sara Eisen, CNBC Anchor, the panel discussion was about fostering
economic growth and innovation, revitalizing the consumer and supply chains. Joining Lourenco was
Ana Botin, Santander Executive Chairman and John Furner, Walmart U.S. President. To view the panel
discussion, view the video below.

## Cleveland-Cliffs Awarded 2025 GM Supplier of the Year by General Motors

Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. was named a 2025 GM Supplier of the Year by General Motors at its 34th annual
Supplier of the Year event. Cleveland-Cliffs was the only North American steel producer recognized
this year. This is the ninth time the company has received the award.

[ View Press Release ][47]

## Congressional Steel Caucus Hearing

Lourenco Goncalves, Cliffs Chairman, President & Chief Executive Officer and the Board Chairman of
the American Iron and Steel Institute provided testimony at the Congressional Steel Caucus held on
January 14, 2026.  Mr. Goncalves spoke about the importance of maintaining Section 232 steel tariffs
and fair trade for the steel industry in the United States. 

The Congressional Steel Caucus is a bipartisan group of U.S. Representatives and Senators working to
support the American steel industry, its workers, and its vital role in national security and
infrastructure, advocating through legislation, meetings with officials, and challenging unfair
trade practices.

Read Mr. Goncalves' testimony, [click here][48]

[ Watch Steel Caucus Hearing on YouTube ][49]

## Cleveland-Cliffs Announces POSCO as MoU Counterparty

Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is pleased to announce that POSCO, Korea’s largest steelmaker and the world’s
third largest steelmaker outside of China, is its strategic partner under the previously disclosed
transformative Memorandum of Understanding. The MoU between the two companies was executed on
September 17, 2025. With the recent completion of the new U.S. and Korea trade agreement,
cooperation between the two nations’ industrial sectors will be further reinforced by the
POSCO-Cliffs partnership.

Read more in the complete News Release.

[ Read News Release ][50]

## Steel Tariffs

The United States’ steel tariffs continue to play a vital role in supporting the long-term strength,
stability, and competitiveness of the domestic steel industry. In 2025, President Trump restored the
effectiveness of steel Section 232 tariffs by increasing the tariff rate from 25% to 50%, completely
eliminating exclusions and exemptions that had drastically weakened the measures and adding Section
232 tariff coverage of certain steel  derivative products. Trade measures such as Section 232
tariffs are essential to countering persistent global steel overcapacity and unfair trade practices
that distort markets and undermine U.S. producers. These tariff measures help ensure that America
maintains a reliable domestic steel supply critical to sustain U.S. national security.

There are early indications of positive impact, including moderated import pressure and improved
conditions for domestic production. Full year 2025 finished steel imports were down 17% vs. 2024.
However, the full benefits of these tariffs will take time to be fully realized. Steelmaking is a
capital-intensive, long-cycle industry, and meaningful gains in capacity utilization, reinvestment,
and workforce development occur gradually.

## CNBC Invest in America Forum

Lourenco Goncalves, Cleveland-Cliffs Chairman, President & CEO participated at the CNBC Invest in
America Forum. Moderated by Sara Eisen, CNBC Anchor, the panel discussion was about fostering
economic growth and innovation, revitalizing the consumer and supply chains. Joining Lourenco was
Ana Botin, Santander Executive Chairman and John Furner, Walmart U.S. President. To view the panel
discussion, view the video below.

## Shape the future

Gerdau is a leading global steel producer. Each year, we transform more than 10 million tons
of recycled scrap metal into new, world-class steel products.

 

In North America, Gerdau operates a network of metals recycling locations, steel mills, and
downstream facilities, manufacturing a wide range of steel products, including: merchant
bar; structural steel; piling; special bar quality; and rebar. We provide our business partners with
outstanding products and services, generating value for all.

 

We are proud to grow with the communities where we work and live; supporting families, building
careers, and shaping a better future.

## See how our metals take shape from mines to homes to outer space

[ Read more ][178]

### Mines

### Refineries

### Smelters

### Flat rolled products (FRP)

### Extrusions

### Foils

### Specialty Alloys

[Mines]

### Mines

This is the first step in our integrated value chain. We operate 27 bauxite mines across Jharkhand,
Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and Maharashtra which are fueled by our four captive coal mines.

[Refineries]

### Refineries

Once bauxite is mined, it is processed into alumina at our state-of-the-art alumina refineries in
Utkal, Renukoot, Muri, and Belagavi.

[Smelters]

### Smelters

We extract aluminium from alumina at our smelters, which have a combined annual production capacity
of 1.3 million MT. Our smelters manufacture high-quality primary aluminium in the form of ingots,
billets and wire rods which are used across industrial settings.

[Flat rolled products (FRP)]

### Flat rolled products (FRP)

Along with our subsidiary Novelis, we lead the world in flat-rolled aluminium products, serving
diverse markets from construction to cookware. Our FRP offerings include hot rolled plates, fin
stock, pattern sheets, and cable wrap stock.

[Extrusions]

### Extrusions

Our customised aluminium extrusions are used across market segments in the making of vehicles,
electrical equipment, consumer appliances and other industrial machinery. Our two extrusion plants
are located at Renukoot and Alupuram.

[Foils]

### Foils

We are one of India’s leading manufacturers of foil and foil laminates which are used extensively in
packaging by pharmaceutical companies. Our food-grade aluminium foils are marketed under the popular
brand names – Freshwrapp and Superwrap.

[Specialty Alloys]

### Specialty Alloys

Hindalco through its subsidiary Hindalco-Almex Aerospace Limited (HAAL), is a proud supplier of
aerospace and defence grade aluminium alloys for India’s prestigious space missions like
Chandrayaan, Gaganyaan and other PSLV and GSLV launches.

[Mines]

### Mines

This is the first step in our integrated value chain. We operate 27 bauxite mines across Jharkhand,
Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and Maharashtra which are fueled by our four captive coal mines.

[Refineries]

### Refineries

Once bauxite is mined, it is processed into alumina at our state-of-the-art alumina refineries in
Utkal, Renukoot, Muri, and Belagavi.

[Smelters]

### Smelters

We extract aluminium from alumina at our smelters, which have a combined annual production capacity
of 1.3 million MT. Our smelters manufacture high-quality primary aluminium in the form of ingots,
billets and wire rods which are used across industrial settings.

[Flat rolled products (FRP)]

### Flat rolled products (FRP)

Along with our subsidiary Novelis, we lead the world in flat-rolled aluminium products, serving
diverse markets from construction to cookware. Our FRP offerings include hot rolled plates, fin
stock, pattern sheets, and cable wrap stock.

[Extrusions]

### Extrusions

Our customised aluminium extrusions are used across market segments in the making of vehicles,
electrical equipment, consumer appliances and other industrial machinery. Our two extrusion plants
are located at Renukoot and Alupuram.

[Foils]

### Foils

We are one of India’s leading manufacturers of foil and foil laminates which are used extensively in
packaging by pharmaceutical companies. Our food-grade aluminium foils are marketed under the popular
brand names – Freshwrapp and Superwrap.

[Specialty Alloys]

### Specialty Alloys

Hindalco through its subsidiary Hindalco-Almex Aerospace Limited (HAAL), is a proud supplier of
aerospace and defence grade aluminium alloys for India’s prestigious space missions like
Chandrayaan, Gaganyaan and other PSLV and GSLV launches.

## Who We Are

Nucor is more than North America’s largest and most diversified manufacturer of steel and fabricated
steel products. We are 33,000 teammates committed to delivering innovative, world-class solutions
and building powerful partnerships, strong communities and a sustainable future.

[
[card-image]

### Steel Products

Nucor offers North America’s largest portfolio of steel and fabricated steel products, backed by our
network of 27 steel mills.

][231][
[card-image]

### Industries Served

We are a leading steel manufacturer and solutions provider for the industries shaping the future,
including automotive, energy and construction.

][232][
[card-image]

### Careers

Our most valuable asset is our team. From the steel we make to the communities we serve, being part
of Nucor means building the future together.

][233][
[card-image]

### News

Stay informed with the latest Nucor news and industry updates.

][234]

Safety

Our goal is to become the world’s safest steel company. The most important job we do every day is
creating an environment where every teammate is safe.

[
LEARN MORE
][235]

Talent

A career at Nucor means that your work matters, your ideas count and your future is yours to build.
Discover what it’s like to be part of the team.

[
WORK FOR NUCOR
][236]

Investors

Nucor delivers long-term value through innovation, operational excellence and disciplined growth,
which continually drives returns for shareholders.

##### **The New Frontier Of Growth**

# Sustainable.
# Intentional.
# Transformational.

### Driving Change

BIOEDGE™ is redefining what’s possible in sustainable steel. Through EAF technology, circular
manufacturing, cutting-edge innovation, and sustainably sourced materials, we’re helping industries
decarbonize.
[Learn More][90]

##### What we do

We are a leading industrial metals solutions company. We operate using a circular manufacturing
model, producing lower-carbon-emission, quality products with recycled scrap as the primary input.
We are one of the largest domestic steel producers and metal recyclers in North America, combined
with a meaningful downstream steel fabrication platform. The company is also currently investing in
aluminum operations to further diversify its product offerings. Our circular economy is driven by
the passion and dedication of our innovative teams at each of our operating platforms: steel, steel
fabrication, metals recycling, and aluminum.

[LEARN ABOUT OUR CIRCULAR MANUFACTURING MODEL][91]
Recent News
Recent Presentations

## Steel Operations

Our steel operations produce steel products, including hot roll, cold roll, and coated sheet steel,
structural steel beams and shapes, rail, engineered special-bar-quality steel, cold finished steel,
merchant bar products, and specialty steel sections. These operations primarily consist of our seven
EAF steel mills and numerous value-added coating operations with approximately 16 million tons of
steel shipping capability.

[Learn About Our Steel Operations][92]

## Steel Fabrication

Our steel fabrication operations produce structural steel joist and deck building systems. Our steel
fabrication operations have a national operating footprint that allows us to serve the entire
domestic construction market, as well as national accounts.

[Learn About Our Steel Fabrication][93]

## Metals Recycling

Our metals recycling operations collect and process ferrous and nonferrous scrap from manufacturing
and end-of-life items, such as automobiles, appliances, and machinery. This processed scrap is then
sold to end-users for reuse, including our EAF steel mills. Our metals recycling operations are
strategically located primarily in close proximity to our steel mills and other end-user scrap
consumers, throughout the United States, and Central and Northern Mexico.

[Learn About Our Metals Recycling][94]

### Driving Change

BIOEDGE™ is redefining what’s possible in sustainable steel. Through EAF technology, circular
manufacturing, cutting-edge innovation, and sustainably sourced materials, we’re helping industries
decarbonize.
[Learn More][90]

##### What we do

We are a leading industrial metals solutions company. We operate using a circular manufacturing
model, producing lower-carbon-emission, quality products with recycled scrap as the primary input.
We are one of the largest domestic steel producers and metal recyclers in North America, combined
with a meaningful downstream steel fabrication platform. The company is also currently investing in
aluminum operations to further diversify its product offerings. Our circular economy is driven by
the passion and dedication of our innovative teams at each of our operating platforms: steel, steel
fabrication, metals recycling, and aluminum.

[LEARN ABOUT OUR CIRCULAR MANUFACTURING MODEL][91]
Recent News
Recent Presentations

## Steel Operations

Our steel operations produce steel products, including hot roll, cold roll, and coated sheet steel,
structural steel beams and shapes, rail, engineered special-bar-quality steel, cold finished steel,
merchant bar products, and specialty steel sections. These operations primarily consist of our seven
EAF steel mills and numerous value-added coating operations with approximately 16 million tons of
steel shipping capability.

[Learn About Our Steel Operations][92]

## Steel Fabrication

Our steel fabrication operations produce structural steel joist and deck building systems. Our steel
fabrication operations have a national operating footprint that allows us to serve the entire
domestic construction market, as well as national accounts.

[Learn About Our Steel Fabrication][93]

## Metals Recycling

Our metals recycling operations collect and process ferrous and nonferrous scrap from manufacturing
and end-of-life items, such as automobiles, appliances, and machinery. This processed scrap is then
sold to end-users for reuse, including our EAF steel mills. Our metals recycling operations are
strategically located primarily in close proximity to our steel mills and other end-user scrap
consumers, throughout the United States, and Central and Northern Mexico.

[Learn About Our Metals Recycling][94]

## Collective Bargaining negotiations

## Build the Future Together

# WELCOME TO
# THE FUTURE OF
# STEEL.

The transformation of U. S. Steel continues as we focus on delivering sustainable, visionary steel
solutions that serve customers and communities, people and planet.

## Home Banner 125 year

### 125 YEARS. ONE POWERFUL LEGACY.

Built by people who show up, work hard, and never back down. We’re celebrating the strength that
connects us and carries us forward.

[ LEARN MORE ][200]

## Asset Publisher

### NEW &
### NOTEWORTHY

### U. S. STEEL UNVEILS NEW ERA OF GROWTH

U. S. Steel outlined its next era of growth in its partnership with Nippon Steel, including
significant capital investments and world‑class technology sharing that will forge the future of the
American steel industry.

**[LEARN MORE][201]**

X

### NIPPON STEEL AND
### U. S. STEEL –  MOVING FORWARD TOGETHER TO BE THE BEST STEELMAKER WITH WORLD-LEADING CAPABILITIES

**[WATCH VIDEO][202]**

X

### Nippon Steel Corporation and U. S. Steel Finalize Historic Partnership

U. S. Steel to retain its iconic name and headquarters in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and continue to
be mined, melted, and made in America

**[LEARN MORE][203]**

X

### "A LEGACY RENEWED. A FUTURE SECURED."

At Global Steel Dynamics 2025, U. S. Steel President & CEO Dave Burritt gave the closing keynote
address where he shared how our new partnership with Nippon Steel will transform American
steelmaking.

**[WATCH VIDEO][204]**

X

### Facts About Nippon Steel Corporation

U. S. Steel's new partner is one of our industry's largest, most technologically advanced
steelmakers. Learn more about Nippon Steel's capabilities, global footprint, workforce, community
engagement activities, and more.

** [LEARN MORE][205]**

X

## Becoming the Best Steelmaker with World-Leading Capabilities

### Becoming the Best Steelmaker with World-Leading Capabilities

Nippon Steel and U. S. Steel are moving forward together with a common purpose: Become the best
steelmaker for our employees, our customers, our communities, and more.

[ LEARN MORE][206]

## Asset Publisher

###### Road Trip!

### A New Docuseries from U. S. Steel

Join vanlife influencers Court & Nate as they retrace the path of Jackson & Crocker, two dreamers
who completed the first cross-country road trip in 1903. This original docuseries celebrating
travel, history and the automotive steel that makes it all possible.

[ Watch the series ][207]

###### PARTNERS IN INNOVATION

### OUR CUSTOMERS.
### OUR COMMITMENT.

Across our entire business, we’re bringing industry-leading steelmaking talent and technology
together to help customers solve, innovate and excel. Just one example: lighter, stronger steel for
safer, more fuel-efficient vehicles.

[ LEARN MORE][208]

###### SUSTAINABILITY

### A GREENER U. S. STEEL.

This is a greener U. S. Steel, with an infinitely recyclable product, one of the world’s first and
few LEED-certified plants, and a long-term commitment to decarbonize. With increasing mini mill
capacity, we are expanding our ability to make game-changing sustainable steels.

[ LEARN MORE][209]

## Building Mini Mill Leadership to Transform the Future

### BUILDING MINI MILL EXCELLENCE
### TO TRANSFORM THE FUTURE.

Big River Steel is now part of U. S. Steel, bringing mini mill 
leadership, a LEED-certified steel mill and an innovator’s
mentality to our drive to be a leader in sustainable steelmaking and products.

[ LEARN MORE ][210]

# How Glass Speaks to Light^{™}

From the White House to the Burj Khalifa, from the U.S. to Sweden, Germany, and countries all
throughout the world, our glass plays an integral part in some of the most recognizable structures
ever built.

[ Explore projects ][166]

### Bendheim Glass Systems

Precision-engineered, proven, and easy to specify, our wide range of interior and exterior glass
systems offer flexibility and ease of installation for a variety of applications.

[ Explore glass systems ][167]
Z-KISS™ Concealed Interior Glass Cladding System

### Specialty Glass

Join the ranks of world-renowned architects, interior designers, and global brands who have worked
with us to create breathtaking, timeless expressions of beauty in glass.

[ Explore specialty glass ][171]

## Visions Realized

You share your ideas and imagination. Together, with the help of our collaborative Design-Assist
process, we turn visions into reality… without compromise. Our only limitations are the laws of
physics.

1

### Design Assist & System Development

To support the design process, early collaboration and visualization help identify potential
challenges, optimize system details, and align design intent with project budgets.

2

### Design Assist & System Development

Provides access to specialized glass knowledge and systems, feasibility, and structural
considerations. Streamline fabrication, reduce costs, and enhance sustainability.

3

### Unique Facades

Create complex facade geometries on tighter budgets, add texture & depth to the facade.

4

### Ease of Installation

No holes through the glass. Compression fittings easily adjust to field conditions speeding the
construction schedule.

5

### Vision Through Custom Solutions

Bendheim’s ventilated glass facade systems protect structures and/or occupants from wind-driven
rain, snow, and ice, while maintaining natural ventilation and daylight advantages.

6

### Visions Realized

Our engineered glass systems provide safety with durable materials, while ensuring ease of
installation through innovative design. They offer aesthetic flexibility, are cost-effective, and
sustainable.

## Founded in NYC. Known the World Over.

### Years of Innovation

Since 1927, the Bendheim family name has been synonymous with glass innovation. Over time we have
developed decades-long relationships that have been the backbone of our business. From our beginning
in art glass to pioneering numerous processes and systems that are now standards in architectural
glass, our business and success are built on collaboration, trust, and human connection.

# How Glass Speaks to Light^{™}

From the White House to the Burj Khalifa, from the U.S. to Sweden, Germany, and countries all
throughout the world, our glass plays an integral part in some of the most recognizable structures
ever built.

[ Explore projects ][166]

### Bendheim Glass Systems

Precision-engineered, proven, and easy to specify, our wide range of interior and exterior glass
systems offer flexibility and ease of installation for a variety of applications.

[ Explore glass systems ][167]

## Visions Realized

You share your ideas and imagination. Together, with the help of our collaborative Design-Assist
process, we turn visions into reality… without compromise. Our only limitations are the laws of
physics.

1

### Design Assist & System Development

To support the design process, early collaboration and visualization help identify potential
challenges, optimize system details, and align design intent with project budgets.

2

### Design Assist & System Development

Provides access to specialized glass knowledge and systems, feasibility, and structural
considerations. Streamline fabrication, reduce costs, and enhance sustainability.

3

### Unique Facades

Create complex facade geometries on tighter budgets, add texture & depth to the facade.

4

### Ease of Installation

No holes through the glass. Compression fittings easily adjust to field conditions speeding the
construction schedule.

5

### Vision Through Custom Solutions

Bendheim’s ventilated glass facade systems protect structures and/or occupants from wind-driven
rain, snow, and ice, while maintaining natural ventilation and daylight advantages.

6

### Visions Realized

Our engineered glass systems provide safety with durable materials, while ensuring ease of
installation through innovative design. They offer aesthetic flexibility, are cost-effective, and
sustainable.

Since 1927, the Bendheim family name has been synonymous with glass innovation. Over time we have
developed decades-long relationships that have been the backbone of our business. From our beginning
in art glass to pioneering numerous processes and systems that are now standards in architectural
glass, our business and success are built on collaboration, trust, and human connection.

British Steel is one of the leading steel manufacturers in Europe, producing up to 3 million tonnes

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

ABOUT US

Chuzhou Jincheng Metalwork Co.,Ltd,was established in 2007,which is a independent management
manufacturer of exporting scaffolding products.Covering an area of about 102,000 square meters,
there are two factories, the new factory contains galvanized workshop, with employee of more
than500.Professional R & D,production and sales of steel scaffolding and aluminum scaffolding
products, monthly export quantity of more than 600 containers.
We’re a key export-earning enterprise in China.Products are exported to Europe, North America,
Oceania, Southeast Asia and other regions. Our company has gradually improved the after-sales
service system to provide customers with the most convenient after-sales service.
We have passed the ISO9001:2015 quality system certification, EN3834-2 welding quality system
certification, EN1090-2/3 steel and aluminum structure welding quality system certification.
Moreover in line with the EN12811, EN12810, AS1576, AS1577 standard issued by the German TUV
certification authority. And also have reached a number of test standards for scaffolding products
in the EU,such as loading, and welding penetration.

Our equipment can meet the production of all kinds of scaffolding products. The full automatic
production capacity of most products has been realized with advanced and complete automatic
production equipment. Meanwhile, galvanizing equipment have been invested, and the surface treatment
galvanizing of all products will be operated by ourselves. In 2017, the R&D center was established,
and 5 invention patents and 14 utility patents were obtained. 13 invention patents have been
authorized, and the new products and molds involved are independently developed and produced by
ourselves, thus solved the difficult situation of new product development.

ABOUT US

Chuzhou Jincheng Metalwork Co.,Ltd,was established in 2007,which is a independent management
manufacturer of exporting scaffolding products.Covering an area of about 102,000 square meters,
there are two factories, the new factory contains galvanized workshop, with employee of more
than500.Professional R & D,production and sales of steel scaffolding and aluminum scaffolding
products, monthly export quantity of more than 600 containers.
We’re a key export-earning enterprise in China.Products are exported to Europe, North America,
Oceania, Southeast Asia and other regions. Our company has gradually improved the after-sales
service system to provide customers with the most convenient after-sales service.
We have passed the ISO9001:2015 quality system certification, EN3834-2 welding quality system
certification, EN1090-2/3 steel and aluminum structure welding quality system certification.
Moreover in line with the EN12811, EN12810, AS1576, AS1577 standard issued by the German TUV
certification authority. And also have reached a number of test standards for scaffolding products
in the EU,such as loading, and welding penetration.

Our equipment can meet the production of all kinds of scaffolding products. The full automatic
production capacity of most products has been realized with advanced and complete automatic
production equipment. Meanwhile, galvanizing equipment have been invested, and the surface treatment
galvanizing of all products will be operated by ourselves. In 2017, the R&D center was established,
and 5 invention patents and 14 utility patents were obtained. 13 invention patents have been
authorized, and the new products and molds involved are independently developed and produced by
ourselves, thus solved the difficult situation of new product development.

Building on its solid steel core business, the company actively responds to the industry’s
transformation and upgrading requirements by strategically expanding into the new materials sector.
Its business has been extended to photo-responsive specialty coatings and functional building
materials. Through a joint R&D development model, the company continuously promotes the engineering
and industrialization of new materials technologies, gradually forming a diversified business
portfolio covering photo-responsive coatings, container housing solutions, industrial machinery and
equipment, and digital steel services, thereby enhancing efficiency and creating added value across
the steel industry value chain.

Founded by MAX Wang, marking the beginning of steel trading business and providing high-quality
steel supply to domestic and international clients.

### 2007

Expanded into both domestic and international trade, achieving multi-dimensional business
development and broader market coverage.

### 2017

Focused on corrosion protection for metal materials, developing high-performance photosensitive
special coatings to extend the lifespan of steel products.

### 2020

Independently developed a steel pricing software, providing digital and intelligent solutions for
the steel trading industry.

### 2021

Entered the container R&D and manufacturing sector, promoting innovation in construction and
industrial applications.

### 2025

Steadily advancing in the steel trading, anti-corrosion coatings, container, and machinery
industries, enhancing overall competitiveness and business diversification.

# **Custom-Engineered Steel Building Manufacturer**

Nucor Building Systems has been a leader in the design and manufacture of custom-engineered metal
building systems for over three decades. With four strategic plant locations and a coast-to-coast
network of over 1,400 Authorized Builders, we efficiently service customers throughout North America
and beyond. Our metal buildings are fully customized to fit our customer’s unique needs to provide
sophisticated, energy efficient, and environmentally friendly building solutions.  See for yourself
how a metal building can work for you.

[Custom Manufacturing Pre-Engineered Building]

## What Type of Building Do You Need?

As a fully custom steel building manufacturer, your possibilities are endless. Using the latest in
design technology, your metal building will be custom engineered to achieve the optimal solution for
you.

[I NEED A BUILDING][42]

[Add insulation to your roof with R-Boost]

## Increase Roof Insulation with R-Boost

Want an economical solution that helps you achieve increased levels of thermal performance, and meet
increasingly stringent energy codes? R-Boost, Nucor’s new elevated roof insulation system, is your
solution.

[MORE ABOUT R-BOOST][43]

[Metal Building with Insulated Metal Panel Exterior]

## **Insulated Metal Panels** by Metl-Span

An excellent option for nearly any type of building, insulated metal panels by our sister company,
Metl-Span, work seamlessly with metal buildings to offer an economical, energy efficient,
sustainable solution.

[INSULATED METAL PANELS][44]

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. ## Decarbonizing at scale

We're done with dirty.

Cleaning up heavy industry, which is responsible for 40% of all global CO₂ emissions, is key for
tackling the climate crisis. The steel industry alone accounts for more than 7% of the world's CO₂
emissions.

We're on track to produce near-zero emission steel.

[Discover our steel][33]

## It all begins in Boden

Get ready for a fully integrated, digitalized, and circular plant in Boden, northern Sweden. Our
giga-scale electrolyzer, powered by renewable electricity, will be the largest green hydrogen
production plant in Europe. By swapping coal for green hydrogen, we refine iron ore into green iron,
emitting steam – just plain water. This is game-changing innovation making it possible for us to
produce near-zero emission steel, setting a new industry standard. When fully operational, we will
reduce steel emissions by over 7 million tonnes per year. Europe's first new steel mill in 50 years
is on its way.

[Read more][34]

## Hey you! Wanna fight carbon emissions?

Join us in cleaning up the world’s dirtiest industries.

[Check our career page][35]

## Decarbonizing at scale

We're done with dirty.

Cleaning up heavy industry, which is responsible for 40% of all global CO₂ emissions, is key for
tackling the climate crisis. The steel industry alone accounts for more than 7% of the world's CO₂
emissions.

We're on track to produce near-zero emission steel.

[Discover our steel][33]

## It all begins in Boden

Get ready for a fully integrated, digitalized, and circular plant in Boden, northern Sweden. Our
giga-scale electrolyzer, powered by renewable electricity, will be the largest green hydrogen
production plant in Europe. By swapping coal for green hydrogen, we refine iron ore into green iron,
emitting steam – just plain water. This is game-changing innovation making it possible for us to
produce near-zero emission steel, setting a new industry standard. When fully operational, we will
reduce steel emissions by over 7 million tonnes per year. Europe's first new steel mill in 50 years
is on its way.

[Read more][34]

## Hey you! Wanna fight carbon emissions?

Join us in cleaning up the world’s dirtiest industries.

[Check our career page][35]

## Follow the journey

Stegra in agreement with Green Cargo on freight traffic.

2026.04.27

Stegra’s plant in Boden recognized as a net-zero project.

Stegra has agreed in principle on €1.4 billion in new financing.

Only 10 electrolyzer modules left to install at the hydrogen facility.

Partnership with Fortum for renewable electricity.

Partnership with SMS group for the technology to the steel plant.

Partnership with Midrex for technology to the DRI plant.

Secured €190 million in funding

## tk accelis signs 10-year strategic agreement with SKF to strengthen steel supply chain across
## France and the UK

tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions has signed a new 10-year long-term agreement with SKF for the
supply of steel bar products across France and the United Kingdom. Under the agreement, tk accelis
Supply Chain Solutions will manage the supply of steel bar materials supporting SKF's manufacturing
operations, delivering secure, reliable and efficient material availability through an integrated
supply chain approach.

The contract forms part of tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions' Global Control Tower offering, a
comprehensive, technology-enabled solution that combines strategic materials sourcing, supply chain
management, logistics, inventory optimization and digital visibility. Designed to help manufacturers
navigate increasingly complex global supply chains, the Global Control Tower provides end-to-end
transparency, predictive planning and proactive risk management while supporting the availability of
materials where and when customers need them.

By integrating materials supply with advanced supply chain management capabilities, tk accelis
Supply Chain Solutions will support SKF in enhancing operational resilience, improving inventory
performance and increasing supply chain efficiency across its operations in France and the UK.

François Pillavoine, Chief Sales Officer at tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions France, said:

"This long-term agreement demonstrates the trust SKF has placed in tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions
as a strategic supply chain partner. We look forward to continuing our partnership with SKF over the
next decade and supporting their long-term manufacturing ambitions."

Ivan Bourgeois, Aerospace Purchasing Manager Europe at SKF, added:

"This long-term agreement with tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions represents an important step in
supporting our continued growth across France and the UK. Having a trusted partner with deep
materials expertise and a resilient global supply network enables us to enhance operational
efficiency, improve supply continuity and respond with greater agility to evolving market demands.”

The agreement reflects the growing demand for strategic partnerships that extend beyond traditional
materials distribution, enabling manufacturers to build more agile, data-driven and resilient supply
chains capable of responding to changing market conditions.

## tk accelis awarded five-year Airbus A220 material supply contract from Dynamatic Technologies

tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions has been awarded a five-year contract by Dynamatic Technologies
Limited (DTL) in India to support the Airbus Atlantic A220 program’s all door package, which

Dynamatic Technologies over many years,” said Gopi Hanumanthappa, Managing Director at tk accelis

aerospace supply chain that will support future growth opportunities and further strengthen India’s
position as a global aerospace manufacturing hub.”

Toby Malhoutra, CEO & Managing Director at Dynamatic Technologies said: “As the aerospace sector
continues to evolve, both of our companies remain committed to investing in capabilities that drive
competitiveness, resilience and innovation. The latest contract highlights the increasing importance
of strategic partnerships in building a robust regional supply chain and supporting the continued
growth of India’s aerospace industry.”

world-class manufacturing performance in India for one of the aviation industry's most successful

## tk accelis presents strategy and targets for independence at Capital Markets Day

][27]
[
* Market leader by sales in Germany and Europe, number three in North America¹; sales of €11.4
  billion in fiscal year 2024/25
* New mid-term financial targets introduced: >4% sales CAGR and adjusted EBITDA margin of 4–5%
* Spin-off of a minority stake to the shareholders of thyssenkrupp AG to be voted on at the
  Extraordinary General Meeting of thyssenkrupp AG on 7 August 2026

tk accelis, a global leader in materials distribution and supply chain services, today hosted its
first Capital Markets Day in London. The company presented its strategy and introduced new mid-term
financial targets – a key milestone on the path towards its planned spin-off of a minority stake to
the shareholders of thyssenkrupp AG and intended stock market listing later this year. Shareholders
of thyssenkrupp AG will vote on the formal spin-off at an Extraordinary General Meeting of
thyssenkrupp AG on 7 August 2026.

**CEO Ilse Henne: **“Our performance demonstrates that tk accelis is ready for the capital markets.
We have shaped the company with the right strategy and the right team. Today, we see ourselves
exactly where industry needs us and where we can create sustainable value. This is why we serve as a
partner of choice for materials and supply chain solutions across many advanced industries. Demand
for our products and solutions is increasing across all our core markets, particularly in North
America. As an independent company, we want to make decisions even faster, take targeted
investments, and grow our higher-margin businesses.”

**Global presence, broad customer base**

tk accelis is the market leader by sales in Germany and Europe and the third-largest player in North
America¹. With operations in more than 30 countries, around 400 sites and approximately 15,500
employees, the company serves some 250,000 customers worldwide. Its ten largest customers account
for less than 10% of annual sales, underlining the breadth and resilience of tk accelis’ customer
base.

The company operates through three business units. The Materials business unit (FY 2024/25 sales:
€7.0 billion²) comprises the distribution business with a strong network across Europe and North

## France and the UK

operations, delivering secure, reliable and efficient material availability through an integrated
supply chain approach.

comprehensive, technology-enabled solution that combines strategic materials sourcing, supply chain
management, logistics, inventory optimization and digital visibility. Designed to help manufacturers
navigate increasingly complex global supply chains, the Global Control Tower provides end-to-end
transparency, predictive planning and proactive risk management while supporting the availability of
materials where and when customers need them.

By integrating materials supply with advanced supply chain management capabilities, tk accelis
Supply Chain Solutions will support SKF in enhancing operational resilience, improving inventory
performance and increasing supply chain efficiency across its operations in France and the UK.

François Pillavoine, Chief Sales Officer at tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions France, said:

"This long-term agreement demonstrates the trust SKF has placed in tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions
as a strategic supply chain partner. We look forward to continuing our partnership with SKF over the
next decade and supporting their long-term manufacturing ambitions."

Ivan Bourgeois, Aerospace Purchasing Manager Europe at SKF, added:

"This long-term agreement with tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions represents an important step in
supporting our continued growth across France and the UK. Having a trusted partner with deep
materials expertise and a resilient global supply network enables us to enhance operational
efficiency, improve supply continuity and respond with greater agility to evolving market demands.”

The agreement reflects the growing demand for strategic partnerships that extend beyond traditional
materials distribution, enabling manufacturers to build more agile, data-driven and resilient supply
chains capable of responding to changing market conditions.

## tk accelis awarded five-year Airbus A220 material supply contract from Dynamatic Technologies

tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions has been awarded a five-year contract by Dynamatic Technologies
Limited (DTL) in India to support the Airbus Atlantic A220 program’s all door package, which
includes the supply and manufacture of all major aircraft doors. Under the terms of the contract, tk
accelis Supply Chain Solutions will provide comprehensive supply chain management services for
Dynamatic Technologies and its network of machined parts suppliers in India.

The scope of the project includes demand forecast management, inventory management, supplier
management, and value-added processing solutions designed to enhance operational efficiency and
program performance.

The contract marks a significant milestone in the relationship between the two companies and
reinforces their shared commitment to strengthening India’s aerospace manufacturing and supply chain
ecosystem. Building on an already established partnership, the agreement further expands
collaboration efforts between the two companies, which also includes supporting production across a
range of global aerospace platforms, including Airbus, Boeing, Deutsche Aircraft, Bell and Lockheed
Martin programs.

“This contract is a testament to the trust, collaboration and shared vision that we have built with
Dynamatic Technologies over many years,” said Gopi Hanumanthappa, Managing Director at tk accelis
Supply Chain Solutions India. “Together, we are creating a more agile and digitally enabled
aerospace supply chain that will support future growth opportunities and further strengthen India’s
position as a global aerospace manufacturing hub.”

Toby Malhoutra, CEO & Managing Director at Dynamatic Technologies said: “As the aerospace sector
continues to evolve, both of our companies remain committed to investing in capabilities that drive
competitiveness, resilience and innovation. The latest contract highlights the increasing importance
of strategic partnerships in building a robust regional supply chain and supporting the continued
growth of India’s aerospace industry.”

By utilising its expertise in aerospace materials, logistics and digital supply chain solutions, tk
accelis Supply Chain Solutions will support Dynamatic Technologies with the goal of delivering
world-class manufacturing performance in India for one of the aviation industry's most successful
programmes.

Universal beams, columns, HSS/SHS/RHS hollow sections, angles, and channels. CE-marked structural

[Request Specs & Pricing →][13]

as standard.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][14]

year service life.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][16]

property data — available digitally within 24 hours of order confirmation.

[Request Documentation][17]

About Us

Tianjin Yinfeng Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

Founded in 1988, Tianjin yinfengzhizao Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. has subsidiaries and
business units in Australia, Singapore, and Bulgaria. Its main products include rebar truss
production lines, rebar mesh welding machines, CNC rebar stirrup bending machines, rebar cage
production lines, rebar bending machines, various intelligent manufacturing production lines,
industrial robots, MES systems, digital twin technologies, and smart factory management systems.
Tianjin yinfengzhizao is a collaborative supplier to China Construction, China Railway Group, China
Communications Construction Company, China Power Construction Corporation, and other leading
enterprises. Its products are exported to over 100 overseas projects, including those in Russia and
Argentina. Major customers include China Construction Technology’s factories in Shenzhen, Huzhou,
Guiyang, and others; SANY Construction Machinery; Dalian Zhengda; Beijing Construction Engineering;
Shanghai Construction Engineering; China Construction Third Bureau in Wuhan; Chongqing CCCC
Prefabricated Construction; Guangdong Zhit; Hainan Weite; Hebei Xindadi; Dezhou Haitian; Hong Kong
Huaxie; Taiwan Peibo Steel; Taiwan Quanyi; Russia’s DSK and SU555; the Moscow–Saint Petersburg
high-speed rail project and BTS-Most; Uzbekistan’s BTB; India’s EEE; Saudi Arabia’s NEOM New City;
Belgrade Metro Line 1 in Serbia; Macedonia’s KARPOS; Bulgaria’s Reinforcement Company; and
Argentina’s Santa Cruz Hydropower Station, among others. The flexible welded wire mesh machine with
infinitely adjustable longitudinal bar spacing, developed by Tianjin yinfengzhizao, has solved the
longstanding challenge of manually tying rebar mesh in the construction industry. It can produce
more than 400 different specifications of composite slabs and wall panel meshes daily, saving over
40 workers previously engaged in rebar drawing, processing, tying, and inspection. This innovation
was awarded the “Customer-Favorite New Equipment Award” at the 2023 China Concrete Exhibition’s
Three New Product Promotion Event. According to expert evaluations organized by the Hubei Technology
Exchange, its key technologies have reached an internationally leading level. Furthermore, the
“Intelligent Processing Technology for Rebar Products,” a prefabricated building training textbook
co-authored by Tianjin yinfengzhizao, the China Architecture Society, China Construction Technology,
and Hebei University of Technology, stands as a landmark textbook in the rebar processing industry,
serving as a valuable reference for technical and managerial personnel when selecting equipment.
Tianjin yinfengzhizao has also established a Digital Twin Intelligent Manufacturing Center in
collaboration with Hebei University of Technology. The digital twin cloud platform it developed
enables AI to read CAD drawings and automatically generate machine instructions, while
simultaneously converting drawing data into material codes that can be transmitted to the MES
system, significantly reducing manual data entry. This digital twin cloud platform was awarded the
Special Prize at the Second “New Infrastructure Cup” China Smart Construction and BIM Application
Competition. Additionally, Tianjin yinfengzhizao’s CNC rebar processing equipment has been included
in the third batch of the “Belt and Road” Important Products, Equipment, and Technical Services
Recommendation Catalog. After more than three decades of development, the company has become an
industry leader. It looks forward to collaborating with all sectors, continuously driving
technological innovation, and jointly creating a brighter future.

## Build the Future Together

# WELCOME TO
# THE FUTURE OF
# STEEL.

The transformation of U. S. Steel continues as we focus on delivering sustainable, visionary steel
solutions that serve customers and communities, people and planet.

## Home Banner 125 year

### 125 YEARS. ONE POWERFUL LEGACY.

Built by people who show up, work hard, and never back down. We’re celebrating the strength that
connects us and carries us forward.

[ LEARN MORE ][200]

## Asset Publisher

### NEW &
### NOTEWORTHY

### U. S. STEEL UNVEILS NEW ERA OF GROWTH

U. S. Steel outlined its next era of growth in its partnership with Nippon Steel, including
significant capital investments and world‑class technology sharing that will forge the future of the
American steel industry.

**[LEARN MORE][201]**

X

### NIPPON STEEL AND
### U. S. STEEL –  MOVING FORWARD TOGETHER TO BE THE BEST STEELMAKER WITH WORLD-LEADING CAPABILITIES

**[WATCH VIDEO][202]**

X

### Nippon Steel Corporation and U. S. Steel Finalize Historic Partnership

U. S. Steel to retain its iconic name and headquarters in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and continue to
be mined, melted, and made in America

**[LEARN MORE][203]**

X

### "A LEGACY RENEWED. A FUTURE SECURED."

At Global Steel Dynamics 2025, U. S. Steel President & CEO Dave Burritt gave the closing keynote
address where he shared how our new partnership with Nippon Steel will transform American
steelmaking.

**[WATCH VIDEO][204]**

X

### Facts About Nippon Steel Corporation

U. S. Steel's new partner is one of our industry's largest, most technologically advanced
steelmakers. Learn more about Nippon Steel's capabilities, global footprint, workforce, community
engagement activities, and more.

** [LEARN MORE][205]**

X

## Becoming the Best Steelmaker with World-Leading Capabilities

### Becoming the Best Steelmaker with World-Leading Capabilities

Nippon Steel and U. S. Steel are moving forward together with a common purpose: Become the best
steelmaker for our employees, our customers, our communities, and more.

[ LEARN MORE][206]

## Asset Publisher

###### Road Trip!

### A New Docuseries from U. S. Steel

Join vanlife influencers Court & Nate as they retrace the path of Jackson & Crocker, two dreamers
who completed the first cross-country road trip in 1903. This original docuseries celebrating
travel, history and the automotive steel that makes it all possible.

[ Watch the series ][207]

###### PARTNERS IN INNOVATION

### OUR CUSTOMERS.
### OUR COMMITMENT.

Across our entire business, we’re bringing industry-leading steelmaking talent and technology
together to help customers solve, innovate and excel. Just one example: lighter, stronger steel for
safer, more fuel-efficient vehicles.

[ LEARN MORE][208]

###### SUSTAINABILITY

### A GREENER U. S. STEEL.

This is a greener U. S. Steel, with an infinitely recyclable product, one of the world’s first and
few LEED-certified plants, and a long-term commitment to decarbonize. With increasing mini mill
capacity, we are expanding our ability to make game-changing sustainable steels.

[ LEARN MORE][209]

## Building Mini Mill Leadership to Transform the Future

### BUILDING MINI MILL EXCELLENCE
### TO TRANSFORM THE FUTURE.

Big River Steel is now part of U. S. Steel, bringing mini mill 
leadership, a LEED-certified steel mill and an innovator’s
mentality to our drive to be a leader in sustainable steelmaking and products.

[ LEARN MORE ][210]

## Build the Future Together

# WELCOME TO
# THE FUTURE OF
# STEEL.

The transformation of U. S. Steel continues as we focus on delivering sustainable, visionary steel
solutions that serve customers and communities, people and planet.

## Home Banner 125 year

### 125 YEARS. ONE POWERFUL LEGACY.

Built by people who show up, work hard, and never back down. We’re celebrating the strength that
connects us and carries us forward.

[ LEARN MORE ][200]

## Asset Publisher

### NEW &
### NOTEWORTHY

### U. S. STEEL UNVEILS NEW ERA OF GROWTH

U. S. Steel outlined its next era of growth in its partnership with Nippon Steel, including
significant capital investments and world‑class technology sharing that will forge the future of the
American steel industry.

**[LEARN MORE][201]**

X

### NIPPON STEEL AND
### U. S. STEEL –  MOVING FORWARD TOGETHER TO BE THE BEST STEELMAKER WITH WORLD-LEADING CAPABILITIES

**[WATCH VIDEO][202]**

X

### Nippon Steel Corporation and U. S. Steel Finalize Historic Partnership

U. S. Steel to retain its iconic name and headquarters in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and continue to
be mined, melted, and made in America

**[LEARN MORE][203]**

X

### "A LEGACY RENEWED. A FUTURE SECURED."

At Global Steel Dynamics 2025, U. S. Steel President & CEO Dave Burritt gave the closing keynote
address where he shared how our new partnership with Nippon Steel will transform American
steelmaking.

**[WATCH VIDEO][204]**

X

### Facts About Nippon Steel Corporation

U. S. Steel's new partner is one of our industry's largest, most technologically advanced
steelmakers. Learn more about Nippon Steel's capabilities, global footprint, workforce, community
engagement activities, and more.

** [LEARN MORE][205]**

X

## Becoming the Best Steelmaker with World-Leading Capabilities

### Becoming the Best Steelmaker with World-Leading Capabilities

Nippon Steel and U. S. Steel are moving forward together with a common purpose: Become the best
steelmaker for our employees, our customers, our communities, and more.

[ LEARN MORE][206]

## Asset Publisher

###### Road Trip!

### A New Docuseries from U. S. Steel

Join vanlife influencers Court & Nate as they retrace the path of Jackson & Crocker, two dreamers
who completed the first cross-country road trip in 1903. This original docuseries celebrating
travel, history and the automotive steel that makes it all possible.

[ Watch the series ][207]

###### PARTNERS IN INNOVATION

### OUR CUSTOMERS.
### OUR COMMITMENT.

Across our entire business, we’re bringing industry-leading steelmaking talent and technology
together to help customers solve, innovate and excel. Just one example: lighter, stronger steel for
safer, more fuel-efficient vehicles.

[ LEARN MORE][208]

###### SUSTAINABILITY

### A GREENER U. S. STEEL.

This is a greener U. S. Steel, with an infinitely recyclable product, one of the world’s first and
few LEED-certified plants, and a long-term commitment to decarbonize. With increasing mini mill
capacity, we are expanding our ability to make game-changing sustainable steels.

[ LEARN MORE][209]

## Building Mini Mill Leadership to Transform the Future

### BUILDING MINI MILL EXCELLENCE
### TO TRANSFORM THE FUTURE.

Big River Steel is now part of U. S. Steel, bringing mini mill 
leadership, a LEED-certified steel mill and an innovator’s
mentality to our drive to be a leader in sustainable steelmaking and products.

[ LEARN MORE ][210]

## La Lettre [Vernimmen.net][67]

Tous les mois depuis 2001, elle apporte à ses 55 000 abonnés un article de réflexion sur l’actualité
financière, un graphique ou un tableau statistique utile dans leur pratique de la finance, une revue
d’un travail de recherche et une question avec sa réponse.

[[Pictogramme j’aime Facebook.]][68]

## Réseaux sociaux

Régulièrement nous commentons l’actualité financière, postons l’une questions à laquelle nous avons
répondu, donnons une nouvelle ou une citation. Devenez nos amis !

[[Pictogramme livre Pierre Vernimmen Finance d’entreprise.]][69]

## Le Vernimmen 2026

Découvrez les principales caractéristiques du Vernimmen 2026, le livre de finance d’entreprise de
référence pour les professionnels et les étudiants depuis 1974, avec plus de 200 000 exemplaires
vendus.

[[Pictogramme micro podcast.]][70]

## Podcasts

Vous trouverez sur cette page les podcasts de nos cours à HEC Paris.
Ils couvrent un spectre très large des thèmes abordés dans le Vernimmen.
Ces vidéos sont devenues l’une des meilleures audiences d’iTunes U.

[[Pictogramme formation.]][71]

## Formations

Que ce soit pour une formation d’une journée ou sur plusieurs semaines à votre rythme, nous avons
conçu des formations pour vous aider à progresser en finance d’entreprise.

[[Pictogramme site UK.]][72]

## Le Vernimmen en anglais

Depuis 2005, le Vernimmen existe aussi en anglais, avec un site miroir, [Vernimmen.com][73] où vous
retrouverez toutes les ressources du Vernimmen *in English*.

[[Pictogramme question & réponse quiz.]][74]

## Quizz

Le quizz Vernimmen offre 467 questions corrigées pour progresser dans votre connaissance de la
finance et tester vos acquis.
Les questions sont réparties par grands thèmes (Analyse financière ; Investisseurs et logique des
marchés financiers ; Valeur, politique et gestion financières).

[[Pictogramme glossaire.]][75]

## Glossaire

Le glossaire Vernimmen.net vous donne les définitions de plusieurs milliers de termes de finance, de
bourse et d’économie.
Ce dictionnaire financier permet aux débutants de progresser dans leur apprentissage de la finance
et aux experts de vérifier le sens précis d’une expression.


## Commentaire, question ou citation du jour

### 16-03-2026 :
### Amazon ou la leçon d'endettement

Mardi 10 mars 2026, Amazon a levé 37 Md$ sur le marché obligataire, puis 14,5 Md€ le lendemain.
C’est autant que le précédent record de la plus grosse émission obligataire réalisée par une
entreprise (Verizon, 49 Md$ en 2013), réalisée pour financer une acquisition.

Ici, le but du financement n’est pas la croissance externe, mais le financement des investissements
qui enflent quasi exponentiellement :

11 Md$ en 2019

31 Md$ en 2020

47 Md$ en 2021

72 Md$ en 2024

114 Md$ en 2025

Et 200 Md$ annoncés en 2026, à cause de l’IA et des data centers bien sûr.

Et pourtant, Amazon était toujours en situation d’endettement net négatif fin 2025 : 105 Md$ de
liquidités pour 87 Md€ de dettes bancair

### 22-02-2026 :
### Le B.A.BA de la finance pour les adolescents - Les sept vérités éternelles de la finance -
### Actions gratuites, ETF et dividendes

qui sont sur le site Vernimmen, onglet Lire, section Conférences.

Un groupe de 10 adolescents volontaires pour se familiariser en 2h avec le B.A.BA de la finance. La
présentation est à votre disposition si vous voulez l’utiliser et la partager à vos ados.

Un groupe de 150 professionnels et un autre de 300 étudiants ingénieurs à Kinshasa, où l'un de nous
deux s'est rendu pour rencontrer les participants congolais de la formation totalement digitale à la
finance d’entreprise, ICCF@HEC Paris. Créée avec First Finance, elle résulte de la digitalisation

### Safety and health

The steel industry is committed to the goal of achieving an injury-free and healthy workplace for
all employees and contractors.

[More Safety and health ][23]

### Climate action

Our industry fully supports the aims of the Paris Agreement. We are committed to a low-carbon
future.

[More Climate action ][24]

### Wider sustainability

The steel industry is committed to transparent data disclosure and continual improvement in
environmental performance issues, including water use, air quality, and maximising resource use.

[More Wider sustainability ][25]

[Our people]

### Our people

The success of the steel industry is intrinsically linked to its diverse people. Education and
training for a net-zero future is a priority.

[More Our people ][26]

### Steel is everywhere

Steel is the most commonly used metal in the world. It is everywhere in our lives.

[More Steel is everywhere ][27]

### About the World Steel Association

The World Steel Association (worldsteel) is one of the largest and most dynamic industry
associations in the world, with members in every major steel-producing country. worldsteel
represents steel producers, national and regional steel industry associations, and steel research
institutes. Members represent around 85% of global steel production.

associations in the world, with members in every major steel-producing country. worldsteel
represents steel producers, national and regional steel industry associations, and steel research
institutes. Members represent around 85% of global steel production.

### About Us

#### More than a company, Wanzhi Steel aims to be your trusted steel solution provider and business
#### partner.

Wanzhi Steel, established in 2011, is a leading manufacturer and supplier of diverse steel products
in China. Our main products include hot/cold rolled steel, galvanized steel, galvalume steel, ZAM
steel, pre-painted steel and stainless steel in coil, strip, sheet and plate and so on.

We have two galvanizing lines, one galvalume and ZAM (aluminum-magnesium-zinc) coating line, three
